gameDescriptionHtml:
Most of your actions have been taken away. In each time loop, slide the mouse to kill monsters, crack the puzzles locked by knowledge, and explore the hidden paths! Go deeper in a limited time and discover the truth of the world.

Game Features

  • Just Swipe Your Mouse! – You have been deprived of most of your control methods. What happened? Try to understand the world when you can only slide the mouse. But if you click the mouse, unexpected and dangerous things will happen.
  • Unique Puzzles! – Who created this world? Keep exploring more areas. There are various hidden mechanisms around the world waiting for you to crack.
  • Characters and Items! – You can get different small props in the treasure chest, let them help you. After the battle upgrade, cultivate your character in each round by adding attribute points.
  • NPCs and Story! – Partners went on an adventure together, but were accidentally teleported to different places. Where are they? What happened? Everything is waiting for your exploration!
